metadata.question: Was the cone of Mount Vesuvius, located 12 kilometers southeast of Naples, Italy, fully covered with clouds, as observed with Landsat 8, on January 2, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Mount Vesuvius cone, ~12km SE of Naples, Italy (approximately 40.82°N, 14.43°E) - Date: January 2, 2022 - Collection: Landsat 8 (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2) - Need to check cloud cover specifically over the volcano cone area 2. Masking strategy: - This question is ABOUT clouds, so I should NOT mask clouds - Instead, I need to use the QA_PIXEL band to identify which pixels are cloudy - Check if ALL pixels in the cone area are classified as cloudy 3. Logic to distinguish results: - C1: No Landsat 8 images found for this date/location - C2: Images exist but processing fails (unlikely here since we're just checking cloud status) - C3: Unable to calculate cloud coverage - A (Yes): 100% of pixels are cloudy (fully covered) - B (No): Less than 100% of pixels are cloudy (not fully covered) I'll need to: - Define a geometry for Mount Vesuvius cone (small area around the summit) - Find Landsat 8 image for Jan 2, 2022 - Use QA_PIXEL band to identify cloud pixels - Calculate percentage of cloudy pixels - If 100%, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Mount Vesuvius summit cone location const vesuviusCone = ee.Geometry.Point([14.426, 40.821]).buffer(500); // 500m radius around summit const startDate = '2022-01-02'; const endDate = '2022-01-03'; console.log('Analyzing cloud cover over Mount Vesuvius cone on Jan 2, 2022...'); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(vesuviusCone) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const count = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 images found: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { // Try Landsat 9 as fallback collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(vesuviusCone) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const count9 = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 9 images found (fallback): ${count9}`); if (count9 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat data available for this date/location.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Get the image and analyze clouds const image = ee.Image(collection.first()); const qaPixel = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); // Bit 3 is cloud bit in QA_PIXEL const cloudBit = 1 << 3; const clouds = qaPixel.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).neq(0); // 4. Calculate statistics const stats = clouds.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: vesuviusCone, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const cloudPercentage = stats.get('QA_PIXEL').getInfo(); if (cloudPercentage === null || cloudPercentage === undefined) { console.log('Failed to calculate cloud coverage.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Count total pixels to ensure valid data const pixelCount = clouds.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: vesuviusCone, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('QA_PIXEL').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels analyzed: ${pixelCount}`); console.log(`Cloud coverage: ${(cloudPercentage * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in analysis area.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Final Answer // Fully covered means 100% or very close to it (>99.5% to account for edge pixels) if (cloudPercentage > 0.995) { console.log('Mount Vesuvius cone was fully covered with clouds.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Mount Vesuvius cone was NOT fully covered with clouds.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
